events.title: MPA Professor of Maritime Law Lecture x Singapore Shipping Law Forum 2026:  A Centennial Celebration? The Hague Rules and the Development of International Shipping Law
events.venue: The Westin Singapore 12 Marina View Asia Square Tower 2, Singapore 018961
events.organiser: National University of Singapore Faculty of Law
events.outline: The Hague Rules (1924), the first international framework governing shipper-carrier relations, addressed key issues already reflected in laws such as the US Harter Act and legislation in Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. Despite later amendments (the Hague-Visby Rules and SDR Protocol) and newer conventions (Hamburg and Rotterdam Rules), they remain dominant in international carriage. This lecture examines their enduring relevance, judicial interpretation, challenges, and adaptation to new technologies.

events.title: Sanctions for Legal Ethical Breaches – Determining the Appropriate Sanction for Lawyer Misconduct
events.venue: SUSS Room at the State Courts
events.outline: This seminar focuses on the topic of sanctions, i.e. the punishment which an errant lawyer may face owing to breaches of the legal ethical norms. The aim of the seminar is two-fold: First, to provide a general introduction to the topic of sanctions. Second, to explore in detail the court’s approach in determining the appropriate sanction for a legal ethical breach and to offer guidance in this regard based on the existing case law.

events.title: [WEBINAR] The Right to a safe, stable and healthy climate: From recognition to realisation
events.outline: This event is organised by National University of Singapore - Centre for International Law. This webinar examines the emerging right to a safe, stable and healthy climate as part of the right to a clean, healthy and sustainable environment. Leading practitioners and scholars will explore whether it should be a stand-alone right, the duties of states and corporations, protections for vulnerable communities, climate justice and eco-colonialism, the role of courts, the rights of future generations and nature, and effective ways to implement and advance climate-related rights.

events.title: AI Workshop for Legal Professionals (8 October)
events.venue: SAL Premises, Level 7, The Adelphi #07-01, Singapore 179803
events.outline: Step into the world of artificial intelligence with this practical, in-person workshop designed specifically for legal professionals. Gain foundational skills and the confidence to apply AI in your everyday work—from legal research to drafting and contract analysis. Guided by experienced trainers, you'll explore how to evaluate and use a range of general and legal-specific AI tools effectively and responsibly. Participants will work directly on their own devices with live support, ensuring a hands-on, outcome-focused learning experience.

events.title: Words that Win: Witness Interviewing and Statement-Drafting Skills for Arbitration Practitioners
events.outline: Witness evidence is often the most important and most vulnerable part of an arbitration case. A well-prepared witness anchors a tribunal's findings; a poorly interviewed one can unravel under cross-examination. This workshop teaches young arbitration lawyers rarely-taught skills: conducting witness interviews, distinguishing recollection from reconstruction, and drafting persuasive, ethical statements. Participants interview a "live" witness, draft under time pressure, and confront a late-disclosed document — then debrief with senior practitioners on judgment calls and ethics.

events.title: Certificate in Family Office & Governance
events.outline: This event is organised by Wealth Management Institute Limited. This module introduces the family office landscape, core functions, and role within the private wealth ecosystem. It covers family governance structures, constitutions, councils, ownership and board dynamics, and alignment of values and roles. Participants also examine family dynamics, cultural influences, conflict management, and the legal professional’s role, supported by case studies and practical discussions.

events.title: The Law Society Criminal Trial Advocacy Course 2026+
events.outline:
Following a successful 1st edition in October 2025, the Law Society of Singapore's Advocacy Committee will be working with criminal barristers from the Australian Bar Association for the 2nd edition of the Criminal Trial Advocacy Course.

With a slate of pre-course webinars, experienced speakers from various sides of the criminal justice system and interactive workshops, this Course will broaden your perspectives, sharpen your advocacy skills and enhance your preparation for a criminal trial.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Mediating Mis-selling: The Applicable Law & Guidelines
events.outline: This programme seeks to set out the law and relevant guidelines relating to mis-selling claims and includes the sharing of case scenarios for participants to work on.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Before the Vows: Love, Law and the Practical Realities of Pre-Nuptial Agreements
events.outline: This event is organised by Dentons Rodyk & Davidson LLP. Family law practitioners from Singapore, Australia, US, France and England will discuss key legal and practical issues in pre-nuptial agreements, including enforceability, disclosure, legal advice and cross-border coordination. There will also be a practical scenario where participants will learn how international lawyers can collaborate across jurisdictions to provide coordinated advice and structure agreements that address clients’ cross-border personal, financial and matrimonial interests.

events.title: SMU-IPAS Advanced Certificate in Insolvency and Restructuring Module 8: Financing+
events.outline: This module will discuss the conditions for seeking rescue financing and the various practical challenges associated with it. It will further explore alternative structures for financing without going through a court process. The course will also do an in-depth study of previous cases in Singapore that had sought rescue financing and draw out the learning points for each case.

events.title: Persuasive Writing: Perspectives from the Bench
events.outline: Advocacy should persuade, not merely inform. Join this intimate seminar on the art of persuasive legal writing, seen through the judiciary's eyes. Distinguished speakers, a retired High Court Judge and a Judge of the Singapore International Commercial Court (UK-based), draw on decades on the bench to share what makes legal writing truly persuasive. Whether drafting submissions, pleadings, or affidavits, gain a rare chance to hear directly from judges on what works, and what doesn't.

events.title: [WEBINAR] ALB International M&A Transactions Masterclass 2026+
events.outline: The ALB International M&A Transactions Masterclass 2026 is an intensive, practical programme for legal counsel, corporate leaders and deal professionals seeking the technical clarity and commercial confidence to manage cross-border transactions from the initial term sheet through to completion.

events.title: [WEBINAR & IN-PERSON] Herbert Smith Freehills Kramer - SMU Asian Arbitration Lecture 2026: Caught in the Crossfire: Arbitration’s struggle with sanctions
events.venue: Webinar / Ngee Ann Kongsi Auditorium, SMU School of Accountancy
events.outline: This lecture examines how sanctions affect arbitration, from parties’ ability to participate in the arbitration process, to the enforcement of arbitral awards. It also considers the wider implications for transnational system of commercial justice, including escalation of costs and uncertainty, and weakening of arbitration as a reliable means for resolving cross-border disputes.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Corporate Accountability, Human Rights and Climate Justice in Asia
events.outline: This event is organized by National University of Singapore, Centre for International Law (NUS CIL). This session examines the intersection of climate justice, environmental justice, nature protection, and just transition in Asia. It explores the integration of human rights principles into climate and biodiversity frameworks, recent legal and policy developments, and emerging corporate accountability regimes. The session also considers how trade and investment laws can better align with climate, biodiversity, and human rights objectives to support a sustainable and equitable transition.

events.title: [WEBINAR] E154: Anti-Money Laundering / Combating The Financing Of Terrorism (“AML / CFT”) Course
events.outline: This event is organised by Institute of Singapore Chartered Accountants (ISCA). The course is designed to enable RFAs to demonstrate knowledge and understanding of AML/CFT legislations, regulatory trends and developments in Singapore, knowledge and understanding of the AML/CFT environment in Singapore and international trends and typologies, knowledge and understanding of how to carry out risk assessment and conduct various types of customer due diligence, familiarity with ACRA Guidelines for RFAs and awareness of how ACRA’s Compliance review and inspections impact RFAs.

events.title: LawNet Training Workshop (14 October 2026)
events.venue: SAL Premises, Level 7, The Adelphi #07-01, Singapore 179803
events.outline: This training workshop guides attendees through the new features and functionalities of LawNet.com. Through walkthroughs and hands-on exercises, participants will learn how to use the revamped platform efficiently

events.title: 11th Asian Maritime Law Conference
events.outline: This event is organised by Maritime Law Association of Singapore. The Asian Maritime Law Conference (AMLC) 2026 is a one-day professional development conference organised by the Maritime Law Association of Singapore (MLAS). The conference provides a platform for legal practitioners, maritime professionals, academics, regulators, and industry stakeholders to gain practical insights into key developments shaping the maritime sector.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Navigating the Evolving Tax Landscape: Corporate Structures and Transactions
events.outline: Navigating the Evolving Tax Landscape: Corporate Structures and Transactions is a full-day seminar designed for legal practitioners, corporate advisors, and tax professionals. The program provides a comprehensive analysis of Singapore's tax regulatory framework, focusing on practical legal and commercial implications across corporate deal cycles, asset management, international compliance, and emerging digital markets.

events.title: [WEBINAR & IN-PERSON] International Mediator Accreditation Workshop+
events.venue: Webinar / 137 Amoy Street, Far East Square, #03-06, Singapore 049965
events.outline: This event is organised by Sage Mediation Institute for Leadership Education Pte Ltd. Participants will hone their mediation skills through an in-depth exploration of mediation strategies, agile process-design and the complexities of international mediation. Through rigorous mediation role-plays and the assessment, constructive feedback will be provided for participants to continuously improve their mediation strategy and approach. Participants who pass the assessment are qualified to receive the P.E.A.C.E. Certificate for International Mediators (PCIM) from SMILE.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Ethics in Action Series: The Ethics of Party Representation and Party Conduct
events.outline: This session will consider the standards applicable to parties and their representatives, and the practical and procedural challenges that arise when ethical issues intersect with the arbitral process. It will examine conflicts across legal traditions, including the opportunities and risks of ethical arbitrage, the interplay between professional duties and client instructions, the prevention and management of ethical conflicts, and the development of best practices and professional standards.

events.title: Advancing Muslim Law Practice: Contemporary Issues and Emerging Perspectives
events.outline:
The programme explores emerging issues in Singapore's Muslim law practice, while providing practical insights into the legal and practical considerations arising in matters concerning children.

The programme examines the legal principles, practical considerations and challenges faced by practitioners in advising and representing clients in Muslim law. The session considers how practitioners can navigate the intersection between legal principles, judicial approaches and practical considerations.

events.title: Advocacy My Way: A Fireside Chat with N Sreenivasan SC
events.venue: The Law Society of Singapore (Members’ Lounge) ,28 Maxwell Road #01-03, Maxwell Chambers Suites Singapore 069120
events.outline: In the second instalment of the Advocacy Committee’s “The Path of An Advocate” series, N Sreenivasan SC shares reflections from a distinguished career at the forefront of complex disputes. This fireside chat explores advocacy, ethics, resilience, mentorship, and adapting to technological and professional change, offering valuable insights on building a legal career and legacy grounded in purpose and the profession’s core values.

events.title: The Relevance of OECD Technical Materials for Tax Treaty Interpretation
events.venue: CBFL Meeting Room (Elm Level 1), NUS Law (UTown)
events.organiser: National University of Singapore Faculty of Law
events.outline: The OECD has developed technical materials that contribute to the interpretation of tax treaties, often described as soft international tax law. These include the OECD Model Tax Convention Commentaries, Transfer Pricing Guidelines, BEPS MLI Explanatory Statement and Pillar 2 guidance. This lecture examines their relevance under the Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties and general international law, considering perspectives of both OECD and non-OECD countries.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Charities Essentials: Converting a Charity from a Society to CLG and Duties of Directors and Office-Holders
events.outline: This event is organised by Allen & Gledhill LLP. This webinar outlines the legal considerations and practical steps involved in charities converting from societies to a Company Limited by Guarantee. Also examined are the duties of office-holders and board members of charities under the Companies Act 1967 and Societies Act 1966, including compliance requirements, fiduciary duties, and good governance practices.  The session concludes with a panel discussion with perspectives from the legal practitioners and charity sector leaders.

events.title: The Annual Medico Legal Seminar 2026+
events.venue: One Farrer Hotel, 1 Farrer Park Station Road, Singapore 217562
events.outline: This event is organised by Singapore Medical Association. Enhance your skills in the ethical, legal and communicative aspects of high-stakes care in end-of-life situations. Designed for physicians, nurses and social workers, the programme addresses key clinical and legal considerations, palliative care interventions and navigating difficult conversations with patients and families.

events.title: Procedures and Principles in the Contested Administration of Estates and Trusts
events.outline: The workshop will cover the procedural framework for and principles relating to contentious administration of estates and trusts under the Family Justice (Probate and Other Matters) Rules and other related subsidiary legislation and practice directions.

events.title: Certificate in Wealth, Succession and Legacy
events.outline: This event is organised by Wealth Management Institute Limited. This course provides an overview of the legal and practical considerations in wealth transition and succession planning. Participants examine how purpose and governance influence long-term family decisions, and review key estate-planning tools and structures. The module also explores philanthropic planning and the role of legal practitioners in supporting families through legacy, governance, and wealth-planning discussions.

events.title: Life of Crime: Reflections from the Bar The Craft of Criminal Defence Advocacy, Ethics, Sustainability, Strategy and Access to Justice
events.venue: SAL Premises, Level 7, The Adelphi #07-01, Singapore 179803
events.outline: he programme is intended for criminal practitioners, young lawyers and law students, and offers participants an opportunity to reflect on the competencies, values, and ethical foundations necessary for effective and sustainable criminal practice.

events.title: Navigating the Practice of International Law in Times of Metamorphosis
events.venue: The Arts House (1 Old Parliament Lane)
events.outline: Building on earlier discussions on international law amid geopolitical instability and rapid technological change, this year’s Symposium adopts a practitioner-focused perspective. Marking the 200th anniversary of the Second Charter of Justice and the establishment of Singapore’s Courts, participants will explore how foundational legal principles, ethics and the Rule of Law can guide the sustainable practice of public and private international law in increasingly complex environments.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Disclosure, Not Discovery: Navigating the 2021 ROC Landscape
events.outline: This session will help litigators, junior lawyers and in-house counsel translate the new framework into practical litigation judgment: what to ask for, when to ask for it, how to resist overbroad requests, and how to use document production strategically without losing sight of the Ideals under the Rules of Court 2021.

events.title: ISDA Annual Legal Forum (APAC)
events.venue: Marina Bay Financial Centre, 25th Floor, Tower 3, 12 Marina Boulevard, Singapore, 018982
events.outline: The event is listed by International Swaps and Derivatives Association, Inc. (ISDA). ISDA’s Annual Legal Forum is the premier event for derivatives lawyers and regulatory and compliance professionals. Bringing together senior lawyers, regulators and market practitioners, the event provides the latest intelligence and analysis on the most important legal and regulatory issues affecting markets today.

events.title: Singapore Insolvency Conference 2026+
events.venue: PARKROYAL COLLECTION Marina Bay, Garden Ballroom Level 1
events.outline: This event is organised by Insolvency Practitioners Association of Singapore (IPAS). The Singapore Insolvency Conference 2026 (SIC 2026) brings together the restructuring and insolvency community to examine the evolution and future direction of restructuring and insolvency law and practice in Singapore and beyond. Building on four decades of transformation since the Pan-Electric crisis, the conference will explore how Singapore has developed into a leading international restructuring hub and consider the opportunities and challenges that lie ahead.

events.title: STEP Asia Conference 2026: Advising Families in an Emerging New World Order+
events.venue: Marina Bay Sands Expo & Convention, 10 Bayfront Avenue, Singapore 018956
events.outline: This event is organised by STEP (Singapore Branch). This Conference unpacks the latest emerging trends and innovative strategies shaping family advisory in today’s evolving landscape. Hear directly from experts in Australia, China, India, Indonesia, South Korea & Vietnam on how family needs are evolving across Asia. Sessions address core succession planning challenges: from tax transparency & compliance requirements to strategic family structures & sensitive matters e.g. matrimonial disputes, family governance & alternative dispute resolution.

events.title: CIL’s Dialogue with Turkish Ambassador Sadik Arslan on Türkiye’s response to strategic shifts in the global order
events.venue: Seminar Room 4-4 @ NUS Bukit Timah Campus, Block B, Level 4, 469 Bukit Timah Road, Singapore 259756
events.outline: This event is organised by NUS Centre for International Law. As geopolitical competition and regional crises reshape the international order, Türkiye pursues an active, multidimensional foreign policy grounded in dialogue and pragmatism. Drawing on its geography and diplomatic ties, it contributes through mediation, cooperation and institution-building. This discussion explores Türkiye’s response to global challenges and how flexible cooperation and renewed trust can support multilateral institutions.

events.title: Global Sanctions and Export Controls: Practical Insights for Legal Professional and Businesses
events.venue: Clifford Chance, 12 Marina Boulevard, Tower 3, #25-00, Marina Bay Financial Centre, 018982
events.outline: This networking session brings together senior representatives from legal practice and industry to share practical perspectives on navigating this evolving landscape. Moderated by Kai-Niklas Schneider (Clifford Chance Asia), the discussion will feature Michael Lamson (Linklaters), Andrew Macintosh (FTI Consulting), and Wan-Yi Ho (Deutsche Bank) as they discuss key developments in sanctions and export controls, the practical challenges facing businesses, and considerations for managing these risks in an increasingly complex global environment.

events.title: [WEBINAR] CIL Webinar Series, The (UN)visible United Nations — Episode 2 Book Launch: Law and Practice of the United Nations, Third Edition
events.outline: This event is organised by National University of Singapore - Centre for International Law. Book launch of the third edition of Law and Practice of the United Nations, followed by an expert discussion examining how United Nations law is interpreted, applied and developed through institutional practice, and what 80 years of UN practice reveal about the continuing evolution of its legal order.

events.title: Client Management: Dealing with Vulnerable Clients+
events.venue: SAL, Marina 3, The Adelphi #07-01, 1 Coleman Street (S179803)
events.outline: This 2-day in-person course equips legal professionals with practical skills to effectively manage and communicate with vulnerable clients, including those with mental health conditions, intellectual disabilities, or challenging behaviours. It integrates legal ethics, trauma-informed practice, and real-world scenarios to enhance client engagement and professional conduct.

events.title: STEP Singapore Young Professionals Network (YPN) Forum
events.venue: Meeting Room, Level 3, West Tower Marina One, 9 Straits View, Singapore 018937
events.outline: This event is organised by STEP (Singapore Branch). The Young Professionals Network Forum is designed for early to mid career tax and private client lawyers and wealth management professionals.  It addresses contemporary industry issues, essential technical know-how and crucial professional skills development. It also offers a valuable networking platform to empower future leaders. Participants will receive a Certificate of Participation from STEP Singapore, recognising their commitment to professional growth.

events.title: The Law Society Civil Trial Advocacy Course 2026+
events.outline: The course is an intensive 2.5-day programme which will require participants to prepare and perform as advocates in court, handling case analysis, opening and closing speeches, as well as examination and cross-examination of witnesses. The highlight of the course will culminate in a mock trial where participants, working in pairs, will conduct examination and cross-examination of expert witnesses and deliver oral submissions. At the end of the mock trial, the presiding Judge will provide an extempore judgment along with comments and feedback on the participants’ performance.

events.title: Certificate in Multi-Jurisdictional Tax and Structures
events.outline: This event is organised by Wealth Management Institute (WMI). This module examines how family offices navigate cross-border tax and regulatory environments. It covers key regimes across major jurisdictions, with a focus on Singapore’s Section 13 incentives, licensing and structuring considerations. Participants explore CRS, FATCA, global minimum tax, and emerging trends, applying insights through practical case studies on family office operations.

events.title: Navigating AI, Workplace Fairness and Workplace Investigations: HR Risk Management for In-house Counsel
events.venue: SAL Premises, Level 7, The Adelphi #07-01, Singapore 179803
events.outline: We will explore how counsel can bridge the gap between "knowing" the law and "doing" the work of an operational leader, ensuring that the legal function acts as a driver of sustained competitive advantage rather than a mere cost centre.

events.title: SMU-IPAS Advanced Certificate in Insolvency and Restructuring Module 9: Managing Insolvencies and Risk Management+
events.outline: This module deals with the practical aspects of managing risks in the context of insolvency laws which insolvency practitioners (IPs), such as accountants and lawyers, face when they are appointed.

events.title: Dentons Rodyk Dialogue 2026 - The Singapore Story: Attracting Global Capital, Preserving Trusted Growth
events.venue: Singapore Management University Hall 3,  Basement 1, SMU Yong Pung How School of Law 55 Armenian Street, Singapore 179943
events.outline: The dialogue examines how Singapore has built a deliberate ecosystem of policies and initiatives to attract foreign direct investment and high net worth individuals who contribute to real economic activity, while maintaining stringent regulatory standards. As Singapore positions itself as a launchpad for regional expansion, preserving its integrity becomes equally important, which requires balancing pro-business initiatives with robust anti-money laundering safeguards.

events.title: CML Seminar Series: Who Should Pay When AI Goes Wrong? Producer Liability for Autonomous Ships under English Law
events.venue: The Executive Centre, Level 7, Capital Square, 23 Church Street, Singapore 049481
events.organiser: National University of Singapore Faculty of Law
events.outline: As Maritime Autonomous Surface Ships (MASS) adopt AI for tasks traditionally handled by crews, questions arise over liability when AI causes cargo damage. While claims will usually target carriers, cargo owners and insurers may also pursue AI producers. This seminar argues that existing English negligence law can address AI-related issues, including defect, evidence, causation and remoteness, without new liability rules, and examines implications for insurers and contractual risk allocation.

events.title: [WEBINAR] CIL Distinguished Speaker Series: Fossil Fuel Feuds at the International Court of Justice (ICJ)
events.outline: This event is organised by National University of Singapore - Centre for International Law. The ICJ’s climate change Advisory Opinion identifies fossil fuel production, licensing and subsidies as activities subject to international climate obligations, potentially constituting wrongful acts. This presentation examines the scientific and legal background, the proceedings, the Court’s reasoning and limits, and the Opinion’s impact. It concludes that, while a legal duty to phase out fossil fuels remains uncertain, states expanding production or maintaining subsidies are now on notice.

events.title: AI Workshop for Legal Professionals (29 October)
events.venue: SAL Premises, Level 7, The Adelphi #07-01, Singapore 179803
events.outline: Step into the world of artificial intelligence with this practical, in-person workshop designed specifically for legal professionals. Gain foundational skills and the confidence to apply AI in your everyday work—from legal research to drafting and contract analysis. Guided by experienced trainers, you'll explore how to evaluate and use a range of general and legal-specific AI tools effectively and responsibly. Participants will work directly on their own devices with live support, ensuring a hands-on, outcome-focused learning experience.

events.title: IT LAW SERIES: Leveraging Technology Tools in the Legal Sector
events.outline: This seminar series aims to provide participants with an overview of some of the latest IT law issues and developments. Every session focuses on a different topic and will be conducted by a variety of leading practitioners and academics in the relevant field, who will deliver presentations and participate in a Q&A discussion with opportunities for participants to pose questions.

events.title: Inside The Income Tax Implications of Trusts
events.venue: Seminar Room 2.8, School of Economics Singapore Management University, 90 Stamford Road Singapore 178903
events.outline: This event is organised by Singapore Chartered Tax Professionals. Trusts can arise in a wide range of situations, but their income tax treatment can be complex. Join in for a practical introduction to trusts law before examining how income tax applies across different trust arrangements. Gain a clearer understanding of the taxation of beneficiaries, trusts and the tax implications of beneficial ownership. This in-person session will help strengthen your understanding of the key principles and tax considerations to look out for when trusts arise in practice.

events.title: [WEBINAR & IN-PERSON] Singapore’s Latest Insolvency Reforms: What Will They Mean in Practice?
events.venue: Webinar / Allen & Gledhill Auditorium, 31F One Marina Boulevard, Singapore 018989
events.outline: This event is organised by INSOL International (Asia) Ltd in partnership with the Centre for Asian Legal Studies, Faculty of Law, National University of Singapore, and Allen & Gledhill. This hybrid event will bring together senior legal, financial and restructuring professionals to examine the latest recommended reforms to Singapore’s corporate restructuring and insolvency framework. These recommendations include addressing aspects of judicial management, cross-class cramdown and restructuring tools, as well as cross-border and enterprise group insolvency. With the recommendations moving towards implementation, the panel will discuss what they could mean in practice.

events.title: [WEBINAR & IN-PERSON] Lexplorer Workshop Series 4: From Self-Insight to Career Strategy+
events.venue: Singapore Academy of Law (SAL) The Adelphi, 1 Coleman Street #07-01, Singapore 179803
events.outline: Join this transformative two-part lunchtime career navigation workshop, designed for legal professionals from any legal industry career track (with up to 15 years PQE). Facilitated by certified life coach Susan de Silva (The Silva Coach) and SAL legal professionals, this experience empowers you to take charge of your journey and build a meaningful, sustainable legal career. Through a blend of guided reflection, peer sharing and practical tools (like the LX Career Planner and LIFTED Self-Assessment Tool).

events.title: Certificate in ESG, Philanthropy, and Sustainable Investing
events.venue: Classroom at WMI, One Marina Boulevard, Singapore 018989
events.outline: The event is organised by Wealth Management Institute Limited. It examines philanthropy advisory, stakeholder management, ESG and sustainable investing within family office and private wealth contexts. Through governance discussions, case studies and practical applications, participants will explore philanthropic structures, sustainable investment approaches, stewardship, stakeholder considerations, greenwashing risks and governance frameworks relevant to advising private clients and family offices.

events.title: SMU-IPAS Advanced Certificate in Insolvency and Restructuring Module 11: Capstone - Integrating the Concepts+
events.outline: This module will integrate and provide a coherent overview of the various insolvency and restructuring concepts, knowledge and tools taught in Modules 1 to 10 of the SMU-IPAS Graduate Certificate in Insolvency and Restructuring through a combination of lecture and case study.

events.title: Certificate for Family Office Practitioner – Family Office Management and Operations
events.venue: Classroom at WMI, One Marina Boulevard, Singapore 018989
events.outline: This event is organised by Wealth Management Institute Limited. This course provides participants with an overview of the key considerations involved in family office design and management and equips them with the practical knowledge required to understand, establish, support and operate family offices.

events.title: LES Singapore Basic Licensing Course 2026+
events.outline: Understand aspects of the licensing of intellectual property (IP) – particularly for trade marks, copyright, patents, and registered designs – at the LES Singapore Basic Licensing Course 2026! Organised together with the Licensing Executives Society (Singapore), our programme will cover the various principles and procedures involved in licensing negotiations. Learn how to effectively apply them in practice, through a “hands-on” scenario.

events.title: [APCEL-EWBCLB Book Launch] The Oxford Handbook of Climate Change and Private Law
events.venue: Yale-NUS College Performance Hall  NUS Law (UTown), Kent Ridge Campus
events.organiser: National University of Singapore Faculty of Law
events.outline: The Oxford Handbook of Climate Change and Private Law edited by Douglas A. Kysar (Yale) and Ernest Lim (NUS) offers a comprehensive scholarly assessment of the impacts of climate change for private law. It brings together a team of world-leading experts to examine the interface between private law and climate change, including how existing private law can respond to climate change and whether private law itself might be impacted by climate change.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Data Poisoning and International Law
events.outline: This event is organised by National University of Singapore - Centre for International Law. What happens when an adversary corrupts the data that AI systems rely on? As militaries use AI for intelligence, targeting and operations, data poisoning could disrupt decisions without physical force. This CIL panel examines when such interference might breach international law, including rules on intervention, use of force, deception, perfidy and attacks during armed conflict. Experts will discuss how existing legal rules apply when data becomes both a weapon and a vulnerability.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Decarbonization of the International Maritime Sector: The IMO Regimes
events.outline: This webinar is organised by NUS - Centre for International Law. This module examines the legal, institutional, and policy foundations of maritime decarbonization. It explores the role of the IMO in regulating shipping emissions, the evolution of its climate strategy, and key regulatory measures aimed at achieving net-zero emissions. The session also considers emerging frameworks, alternative fuels, and challenges relating to equity, infrastructure, emissions accounting, and the effectiveness of international climate action in the maritime sector.

events.title: AI Workshop for Legal Professionals (5 November)
events.venue: SAL Premises, Level 7, The Adelphi #07-01, Singapore 179803
events.outline: Step into the world of artificial intelligence with this practical, in-person workshop designed specifically for legal professionals. Gain foundational skills and the confidence to apply AI in your everyday work—from legal research to drafting and contract analysis. Guided by experienced trainers, you'll explore how to evaluate and use a range of general and legal-specific AI tools effectively and responsibly. Participants will work directly on their own devices with live support, ensuring a hands-on, outcome-focused learning experience.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Sustainability Apex Programme Masterclass #11: Sustainable Supply Chain Management
events.outline: This masterclass examines sustainable supply chain management and its role in strengthening resilience, corporate accountability, and long-term value creation. Topics include responsible sourcing, supplier due diligence, traceability, scope 3 decarbonisation, and emerging regulatory developments. The session also covers procurement, contractual, disclosure, and transparency considerations relevant to managing sustainability-related issues across organisational supply networks.

events.title: LES Singapore Intermediate Licensing Course 2026
events.outline: Understand aspects of the licensing of intellectual property (IP) – particularly for trade marks, copyright, patents, and registered designs – at the LES Singapore Intermediate Licensing Course 2026! Organised together with the Licensing Executives Society (Singapore), our programme will cover the various principles and procedures involved in licensing negotiations.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Candour Counts: Guiding practice trainees through the duty of candour in Bar admission
events.outline: In this online panel discussion, experienced counsel will discuss the evolving jurisprudence on the duty of candour in admission proceedings and the principles that have emerged from recent decisions. The panellists will consider common disclosure scenarios, the role of supervising solicitors in guiding and rehabilitating trainees, and how to instil the duty of candour from the very start of a lawyer's professional journey.

events.title: JLP - Advising Clients on Deal Structures
events.venue: SAL, Marina 3, The Adelphi #07-01, 1 Coleman Street (S179803)
events.outline: Explore ethical issues, basic deal design structures, and factors influencing deal structure. Examine contractual and cross-border issues and understand the role of deal lawyers in managing these elements.

events.title: [WEBINAR] Adjudication Insights 2026 - Recent Developments and Recurring Issues Under the Security of Payment Regime
events.outline: This seminar provides a considered update on recent adjudication determinations and review decisions under the SOP Act. Drawing on a detailed commentary of AA and ARA decisions handed down over the past year, the session examines the reasoning underlying these decisions, identifies points of divergence between adjudicators, and offers a view on where the law may be expected to develop.

events.title: AI and Corporate Governance:  Ethics and Oversight of the AI Compliance Program
events.outline: This Masterclass is designed to give participants both the ethical grounding and the practical governance tools needed to oversee AI responsibly. Participants will leave with a working framework for advising on, building, and overseeing AI governance and compliance programs grounded in fiduciary duties, regulatory guidance, and practical implementation experience.

events.title: AI Workshop for Legal Professionals (12 November)
events.venue: SAL Premises, Level 7, The Adelphi #07-01, Singapore 179803
events.outline: Step into the world of artificial intelligence with this practical, in-person workshop designed specifically for legal professionals. Gain foundational skills and the confidence to apply AI in your everyday work—from legal research to drafting and contract analysis. Guided by experienced trainers, you'll explore how to evaluate and use a range of general and legal-specific AI tools effectively and responsibly. Participants will work directly on their own devices with live support, ensuring a hands-on, outcome-focused learning experience.

events.title: [WEBINAR & IN-PERSON] Mediation Advocacy Skills+
events.venue: Webinar / 137 Amoy Street, Far East Square, #03-06, Singapore 049965
events.outline: This event is organised by Sage Mediation Institute for Leadership Education. As mediation gains prominence, advocates must stay updated and effective, not only in the courtroom but also at the mediation table. This workshop covers the thoughtful preparation needed for an advocate to prepare the client for an international mediation and how an advocate can engage effectively with counterparties and the mediator. Advocates who complete the full workshop may accredit themselves as IMI-Certified Mediation Advocates.

events.title: Certificate in AML, Fiduciary Duties and Regulatory Compliance
events.venue: Classroom at WMI, One Marina Boulevard
events.outline: This event is organised by Wealth Management Institute Limited. The Certificate in AML, Fiduciary Duties and Regulatory Compliance examines AML/CFT obligations, fiduciary responsibilities, regulatory compliance, risk management and governance considerations relevant to family offices, trust structures and private wealth arrangements. Through practical case studies, regulatory developments and enforcement lessons, participants will develop the ability to identify risks, assess compliance issues and provide informed legal and regulatory advice.

events.title: Negotiating Success+
events.venue: National University of Singapore (Kent Ridge Campus)
events.organiser: National University of Singapore Faculty of Law
events.outline: This 2-day workshop will focus on giving participants a working knowledge of the Interests-Based Model of Negotiation created by Roger Fisher and as taught at the Program on Negotiation at Harvard Law School. It will be taught through a mixture of presentations, facilitated discussions and role plays.

events.title: Accelerated Route to Membership International Arbitration (ARM)
events.outline: To provide a fast-track route to Membership through the International (i.e., non-domestic) Arbitration Pathway. The Accelerated Route to Membership has been designed for busy professionals who have some unassessed knowledge of International Arbitration. The aim of the programme is to assess whether the candidate has the knowledge required to understand the process of International Arbitration.

events.title: LawNet Training Workshop (17 November 2026)
events.venue: SAL Premises, Level 7, The Adelphi #07-01, Singapore 179803
events.outline: This training workshop guides attendees through the new features and functionalities of LawNet.com. Through walkthroughs and hands-on exercises, participants will learn how to use the revamped platform efficiently

events.title: SCL(S) Conference 2026: Technology, Legal Innovation and Singapore’s Built Future
events.venue: M Hotel Singapore, Banquet Suite at Level 10, 81 Anson Road, Singapore 079908
events.outline:
Industry leaders, legal experts & technologists examine how S'pore can harness digital innovation yet maintain robust legal safeguards. Through expert panels, case studies & debate, we explore the legal frontiers of Construction 4.0 to chart a course for continued excellence in the built environment sector. Sessions:
The Data Centre Boom
Digital Contract Administration & Claims
Digital Evidence & the Future of Construction Disputes
In AI We Trust? The Evidential Risks of Automating Project Records

events.title: [WEBINAR] Equity’s Shifting Boundaries: Resulting Trusts, Illegality and Limitation in Recent Singapore Litigation
events.outline: This seminar examines recent developments in equity and trusts through several important decisions.

events.title: [WEBINAR] ACRA's Prescribed Anti-Money Laundering Combating the Financing of Terrorism ("AML/CFT") Course
events.outline: This event is organised by Chartered Secretaries Institute Singapore (CSIS). This course intends to equip [Registered Filing Agents (RFAs)] with the knowledge and understanding of anti-money laundering (AML) and counter financing of terrorism (CFT) to enable RFAs to comply with prevailing ACRA and relevant Singapore’s regulatory requirements.

events.title: JLP - Effective Documents and Evidence Management
events.venue: SAL, Marina 3, The Adelphi #07-01, 1 Coleman Street (S179803)
events.outline: This 1-day training equips young lawyers and in-house counsel with practical skills to manage documents and evidence effectively. Participants will learn dispute prevention strategies, evidence preservation, document management, discovery compliance, litigation readiness, and the ethical use of technology through case studies, discussions, and practical exercises.

events.title: Mediation+
events.venue: National University of Singapore (Kent Ridge Campus)
events.organiser: National University of Singapore Faculty of Law
events.outline: This workshop will focus on giving participants a working knowledge of how mediation works, its pros and cons, the conflict resolution model used, the process and stages of mediation, learning to facilitate the resolution of a dispute and dealing with the people aspect of any dispute. The workshop will be taught through a mixture of presentations, facilitated discussions and role plays.

events.title: Mediation Advocacy (Nov 2026)+
events.outline: Mediation Advocacy is a specialised training programme designed to equip lawyers and professionals with the strategic, legal, and practical skills required to represent clients effectively in mediation. This programme focuses on how advocates can add value throughout the mediation process: from preparing clients and developing negotiation strategies, to managing dynamics during mediation sessions and achieving durable settlement outcomes.
